definitions.explanation: Extra payment or benefit provided in addition to salary.
Care or treatment given for an injury or illness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧{手当|てあて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらっている→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧{手当|てあて}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧{手当|てあて}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧３⟦{万円|まんえん}→万円：09900_manen⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{支給|しきゅう}される→支給：02835_shikyuu⟧。
examples.english: A commuting allowance of up to 30,000 yen per month is provided.

examples.japanese: ⟦{応急|おうきゅう}→応急：08193_oukyuu⟧{手当|てあて}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}っておく→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦いざ→いざ：28114_iza⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{時|とき}→〜時：03094_toki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{役|やく}に{立|た}つ→役に立つ：01130_yakunitatsu⟧。
examples.english: Knowing how to give first aid is useful in an emergency.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{転|ころ}んで→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{擦|す}りむいた→すりむく：09100_surimuku⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦すぐに→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧{手当|てあて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My child fell and scraped their knee, so I treated it right away.

notes:
{手当|てあて} has two main meanings: workplace allowance and medical treatment.

MEANING 1 - ALLOWANCE:
Extra payment or benefit beyond base salary.
- ⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧{手当|てあて}: housing allowance
- ⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧{手当|てあて}: commuting allowance
- ⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧{手当|てあて}: overtime pay
- ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧{手当|てあて}: family allowance
- ⟦{役職|やくしょく}→役職：05514_yakushoku⟧{手当|てあて}: position allowance

MEANING 2 - TREATMENT:
Care for injury or illness.
- ⟦{応急|おうきゅう}→応急：08193_oukyuu⟧{手当|てあて}: first aid
- ⟦{怪我|けが}→けが：00787_kega⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手当|てあて}: injury treatment
- {手当|てあて}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give treatment

USAGE:
Context usually clarifies meaning. In workplace discussions, it means allowance; in medical contexts, it means treatment.
